allow: PowerShell($sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\\Sdk'; $adb = Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\\adb.exe'; if \(\(& $adb devices\) -match '^emulator-\\d+\\s+device'\) { Write-Host 'Emulator already running.' } else { Start-Process \(Join-Path $sdk 'emulator\\emulator.exe'\) -ArgumentList '-avd','Pixel_10'; & $adb wait-for-device; while \(\(& $adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed\).Trim\(\) -ne '1'\) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; Write-Host 'Emulator booted.' })
PowerShell(git status --short; git ls-files apps/mobile/package-lock.json; \(Get-Item apps/mobile/package-lock.json\).Length; \(Get-Item apps/mobile/package-lock.json\).LastWriteTime)

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $conns | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess; $conns | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, Path })
PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 34712 | Format-List Id, ProcessName, StartTime, Path; \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=34712"\).CommandLine)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8081/index.bundle?platform=android&dev=true&hot=false&lazy=true" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), bytes: $\($r.RawContentLength\)" } catch { "Bundle request FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); $body = $sr.ReadToEnd\(\); $body.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(2000, $body.Length\)\) } })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8081/apps/mobile/index.bundle?platform=android&dev=true&hot=false&lazy=true&transform.engine=hermes&transform.bytecode=1&transform.routerRoot=app&unstable_transformProfile=hermes-stable" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 300; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), bytes: $\($r.Content.Length\)" } catch { "Bundle request FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); $body = $sr.ReadToEnd\(\); $body.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(3000, $body.Length\)\) } })

PowerShell($adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe"; & $adb -s emulator-5554 shell "logcat -d -v time -t 300" | Select-String -Pattern "exponent|ReactNativeJS|AndroidRuntime|FATAL|expo" | Select-Object -Last 60 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line })

PowerShell($adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe"; & $adb -s emulator-5554 logcat -c; & $adb -s emulator-5554 shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "exp://10.0.2.2:8081"; "launched")

PowerShell($adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe"; & $adb -s emulator-5554 exec-out screencap -p > "$env:TEMP\\claude\\lingora-screen1.png" 2>$null; if \(-not \(Test-Path "$env:TEMP\\claude"\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:TEMP\\claude" | Out-Null }; "saved: $\(\(Get-Item "$env:TEMP\\claude\\lingora-screen1.png" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Length\) bytes")
